datasets.description: Deterministic teaching prices; not market observations
datasets.price_convention: Synthetic positive prices (treated as adjusted closes)
datasets.calendar: Plain weekday sequence; not an exchange trading calendar
datasets.generating_rule: r = clip(0.005*common + 0.01*sector + 0.005*noise, -0.2, 0.2), standard-normal factors, compounded from 100

datasets.description: Five-stock teaching correlation matrix; not market values
Historical daily adjusted closes downloaded from Yahoo Finance
datasets.provider: Yahoo Finance via the yfinance Python package (unofficial API)
datasets.license_or_permission: Yahoo Finance terms of service; downloaded for personal/educational course use. Redistribution not confirmed - do not publish the CSV files.
datasets.price_convention: Close with auto_adjust=True (adjusted for splits and dividends)
datasets.calendar: Trading dates as returned by the provider (US exchanges)
datasets.selection_basis: Hand-picked large US companies in four sectors; not an index membership snapshot
